title: Getting to Backside 50/50 by Lachlan Giles
whyUseful: Lachlan Giles breaks down the entry into the Backside 50/50 and why the position is the safest way to apply a heel hook once you are behind the hip line.

title: 70/30 to Backside 50/50 (Lachlan Giles)
whyUseful: Shows how the 70/30 control converts into the Backside 50/50, one of the standard transitions between the two leg entanglement platforms.

title: Backside 50/50 Heel Hook Defense - BJJConcepts.net
whyUseful: Explains what the defender is trying to do from the Backside 50/50, which is what tells you when to stay in the position and when to come back to Cross Ashi.
